Caveat: `except Exception` does not catch BaseException-only exceptions (KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit); those propagate without recording, which is appropriate.

Trace builder in src/sqllens/tools/_format.py:774-785 emits every public step with 'status' (always) and adds 'error' only when status=='error' and _error is non-empty. Failed-step _error is the card description with 'Tool failed: ' prefix stripped (lines 738-743), so the raw Chroma text is preserved (make_tool_cards in tests/unit/_agent_stubs.py:137 builds 'Tool failed: {error}'). Test (tests/unit/test_memory_unavailable.py:154-157) reads s['status'] and s.get('error'), consistent with this. Nuance: 'error' key is present only on failed steps, not all steps.

First half holds: the message is the constant _MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE (query_database.py:97-102) and is raised unformatted at :726-730, so it never carries the persist path or Chroma text. Second half ('both stay in the server log') is not established by this code: the only log call tied to the open failure (query_database.py:722-725) logs just type(open_error).__name__, not the path or the Chroma message. ChromaAgentMemory._get_client (agent_memory.py:147-149) stores the exception and re-raises without logging. Whether path/text reach the log depends on unrelated callers (e.g. enhancer/default.py:159-162 logs exc_info only on search failure; workflow/default.py:545 has no log there), so the comment's guarantee is not backed by the warning it implies.

results.evidence: query_database.py:718-730 checks agent.agent_memory.open_error after components_to_blocks and before `if is_error` (731), raising AgentRunError(_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE, agent_trace, query_info); independent of is_error/run_sql outcome, so successful run_sql and prior SQL-error turns both get the fixed message. agent_trace built at 708-716 only when effective.show_details. server.py:377-385: AgentRunError with trace -> _trace_error_result (isError, text 'Error executing tool query_database: '+message, trace in _meta); without trace re-raised so FastMCP emits same prefix. open_error (agent_memory.py:154-164) stays set while no client is open.

query_database.py:97-102 the constant is fixed text with no interpolation; it names the config key 'memory.persist_dir' but never the configured path value or any Chroma exception text (only type(open_error).__name__ is logged, line ~722). Raised at lines 726-730 with agent_trace=agent_trace, built at 707-717 from the component stream via build_agent_trace (_format.py:621+), which records per-step status and error. server.py:384-386 returns the trace on the error result. Wording nit: the message does contain the literal config-key token 'persist_dir', not the path value.

agent_memory.py:136-152 _get_client retries chromadb.PersistentClient on every call while self._client is None; on failure it records _open_error and re-raises, on success sets _open_error=None and caches _client, so recovery needs no restart. open_error (154-164) returns None whenever _client is not None, so a late failed open from a concurrent executor thread cannot make later calls error. query_database.py:720-730 raises the memory-unavailable AgentRunError only when agent_memory.open_error is non-None. tools/_agent.py:40-74 get_agent caches the agent singleton, so the same memory instance is reused across calls. memory_info is built from components (query_database.py:683) independent of open_error, so it is unchanged while the store is open.

src/sqllens/tools/query_database.py:720 computes open_error = getattr(getattr(agent, 'agent_memory', None), 'open_error', None). The memory-unavailable raise at lines 721-730 only runs when open_error is not None. With no attribute, or no agent_memory, the value is None. The branch is skipped, and the existing is_error handling (731-737) and the normal return (738-739) run unchanged.

grep of src finds no _identifier_to_system. git diff 874474c..HEAD touches only agent_memory.py, server.py, query_database.py and a test; no default.py or system prompt edit. The agent_memory.py change only wraps the existing open in try/except to record _open_error and re-raise, and adds a read-only open_error property (agent_memory.py:136-164), so post-open memory failures are unchanged. The check in query_database.py (~718-730) runs after send_message completes and after components_to_blocks and the trace build, so the full agent turn runs first. The check only reads the open_error property via getattr and never calls _get_client, so a workflow-handled message makes no open attempt and errors only when a failure was recorded earlier. This is covered by test_turn_without_model_call_raises_only_when_failure_recorded.
